page.title: Staff File Requests
page.subtitle: Review physical file checkout requests submitted by departmental staff. Competing requests for identical files are highlighted by priority.
page.extensionMigrationHint: Return-date extensions need the 0017 database migration applied in Supabase.

table.approveBlocked: A higher priority request exists for this file
table.captionPending: Pending staff file requests awaiting a decision
table.captionExtensions: Return-date extension requests awaiting a decision

badges.competingCountTitle: Other staff members are waiting for the same folder
badges.tieLeaderTitle: Equal priority, granted precedence because it was submitted earlier (FIFO)
badges.samePriorityLaterTitle: Same priority as the leader, but submitted later
badges.lowerPriorityTitle: A competing request exists with higher priority

detail.defaultApprovalRemarks: Approved for physical archive retrieval without special restrictions.
detail.cancelledReplaced: Request Replaced by a Higher-Priority Request
detail.cancelledReasonFallback: This request was cancelled by the staff member before administrative review.
detail.cancelledNote: Cancelled requests cannot be approved. The request history is preserved.
detail.pendingReviewHint: This request is currently waiting for an administrator to approve or reject.

rejection.title: Reject File Request
rejection.intro: Add an official review note explaining why {{file}} cannot be checked out. The requester ({{requester}}) will see this note in their portal.
rejection.reasonPlaceholder: E.g., File is currently restricted for audit review / Physical file temporarily relocated / Competing request prioritized...

conflict.title: Competing Request Allocation Notice
conflict.intro: You are approving the physical file checkout for {{file}}.
conflict.notLeader: This request is not first in line for this file. {{name}} holds the higher-ranked pending request, and only that request can be approved while both are pending.
conflict.approveTooltip: Approve this request and automatically reject competing requests with allocation note
conflict.approveBlockedTooltip: Only the request first in line for this file can be approved.

approval.title: Accept File Request
approval.intro: Confirm that {{file}} can be handed over to {{name}}. The request moves into the issued-file workflow with an expected return date, and the staff member is notified.

issuedBlock.title: File Currently Issued
issuedBlock.intro: This file is currently issued to another staff member and cannot be approved until it is returned.
issuedBlock.missingIssuedAt: Issuance date has not been recorded.
issuedBlock.missingExpectedReturn: Expected return date has not been specified.
issuedBlock.hint: You can approve this request after the currently issued file has been returned and its availability has been confirmed. The request has been left pending.

extension.rejectionReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the return date stays unchanged. The staff member sees this reason.
extension.approvalNotePlaceholder: E.g., Approved — please return the file on the new date.

feedback.notFirstInLine: This request is not first in line for this file.
feedback.competingUpdatedMessage: {{count}} competing request(s) auto-rejected with allocation note.
feedback.extensionUpdateFailed: Unable to update this extension request.
feedback.loadRequestsFailed: Unable to load staff file requests.
feedback.deepLinkGone: That request no longer needs a decision here — it has been approved, rejected or withdrawn. The full list is shown instead.
